verdict.rationale: Docs require every skill's SKILL.md to include a name and description (codex-plugins-docs-13), and the skill-creation flow explicitly asks what the skill does and when it should trigger (codex-plugins-docs-7), plus skills are browsable in a UI panel (codex-plugins-docs-29). However, community commentary raises real doubts about predictability in practice — skills are 'unverifiable' text instructions that require 'pray[ing]' rather than guaranteed activation, and some devs prefer MCP tools specifically because textual skill instructions can't reliably prevent unwanted behavior (codex-plugins-comm-1, codex-plugins-comm-6). Missing for 10: independent evidence that documented trigger conditions actually match real-world activation consistently, and no first-party mechanism (like activation logs or dry-run) to confirm a skill fired for the stated reason.
